decision: independent manual plan review conditionally adopt; revisions below frozen before source edit or measurements
revision: Explicit stack holds dependency iterators, not eagerly reversed full graph frontier. Drop local non-request entry after storing iterator; preserve lazy DFS ordering.
hypothesis: Recursive _check retains full non-root entry dictionaries while visiting parents; iterative DFS can drop these sooner, reducing Python peak allocations and avoiding interpreter recursion depth without cross-call caching.
primary_gate: full check() Python tracemalloc peak reduction >=70% on a 256-node chain with 16KiB content/node
latency_guard: untraced complete-call median regression <=15% in 21 paired randomized AB trials, primary and small/shallow/multi-root/branch controls
correctness: baseline differential results/errors/order plus freshness and long-chain reliability; baseline RecursionError outside recursion depth is explicitly separate from ordinary equality
resource: bounded temporary synthetic SQLite on CPU; no model/API/GPU/dependency installation
scope: Python traced peak is not RSS, SQLite native memory, GPU/KV or inference speed; traced timings not used for latency
supervision: manual host plan/result contexts only; tmux/managed ReviewSession unavailable from prior exact environment; no background service claimed

queries: MemoryLedger check ancestor peak memory recursive deep chain
prior_result_search.reuse: method/compatibility context only; no new metric reuse

fixtures.shape: 32 levels width4, each level depends on all4 preceding level

measurement.gc: collect before each timed call in both arms, collection outside timer
measurement.summary: ratio of per-arm medians for each case, not average and not min
measurement.traced_scope: start tracemalloc before full check and stop only after transaction close/return; build/equality and GC outside; independent of wall samples
measurement.input: fixed stable IDs, canonical fixture spec hash and actual deterministic SQL payload hash; no randomized result selection

candidate_budget: one iterator-frame candidate, <=30 minutes CPU probing/review then save checkpoint if not ready; no repeated tuning to overcome gate
stop: gate fails => retain baseline or save unadopted candidate/negative result; no publication without independent code/data verification and final regression
